name: auto-effort
description: Picks /effort per prompt: Jev (TypeSafe AI) grades how hard the task is, and the turn runs at that level.

enabled.title: Turn auto-effort on
enabled.description: On (default): every session starts with Jev picking the effort. Off: sessions start with your own effort, and the band's button or /auto-effort on turns Jev on for that session.

raise.title: Let Jev raise effort
raise.description: Off (default): Jev can only lower effort below your session setting. On: it can also raise it for hard tasks. In benchmarks, raising cost 4-15% more without changing pass rates.
